[[File:Project_ARC.png|thumb|right|200px|The Project ARC lab]]
'''Project ARC''', which stood for '''Automatic Regenerating Cybernetics''', was a research initiative started by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]]'s [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] division during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was being developed by [[Lanniter Droge]] who was developing mechanical [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] body parts that had the ability to heal similar to flesh and [[Bone/Legends|bone]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Grathan had intended military applications by creating better [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].

However, the Lanniter Droge who was the developer of the technology intended medical applications by providing them as replacement [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] for victims of war. An official of the Sith entered into the [[Lord Grathan's estate|Grathan estate]] who was dispatched by [[Ismar Brengle]] who wanted to plunder the cybernetics to sell it for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Lanniter Droge who communicated by [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] attempted to convince the Imperial official about allowing him to use it for medical reasons instead of selling it.
